40006911.author: पदार्थः
40006911.content: अथ and then, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus (Rama), पञ्चवटीम् to Panchavati, गच्छन्  while going, अन्तरा in the middle, महाकायम् of huge body, भीमपराक्रमम् of fearful strength गृध्रम् vulture, आससाद met.

40006911.author: Translation
40006911.content: On the way to Panchavati, Rama, the delight of the Raghu race, met a vulture with a huge body and fearful strength.

40006912.author: पदार्थः
40006912.content: महाभागौ both the venerable, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ  Rama and Lakshmana, वटस्थम् on the banyan tree, तं पक्षिम् that bird, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, भवान् you, कः who are, इति this way, ब्रुवाणौ (while) saying so, राक्षसम् demon, मेनाते thought.

40006912.author: Translation
40006912.content: Seeing the bird on the banyan tree, venerable Rama and Lakshmana mistook him for a demon and enquired who he was.

40006913.author: पदार्थः
40006913.content: सः he, तौ to them, मधुरया sweetly, सौम्यया in a gentle way, वाचा in a tone, प्रीणयन्निव   pleasing them, उवाच said, वत्स dear child, माम् me, आत्मनः पितुः your father's, वयस्यम् friend, विद्धि know.

40006913.author: Translation
40006913.content: With a sweet, pleasing, and gentle voice he said to both of them, O dear know me to be a friend of your father.

40006914.author: पदार्थः
40006914.content: सः राघवः Rama, तम् him, पितृसखम् father's friend, बुद्ध्वा after knowing, पूजयामास paid obeisance, अथ then, सः he, अव्यग्रम् in a cool and composed manner, तस्य his, कुलम् lineage, नाम च name also, पप्रच्छ enquired of.

40006914.author: Translation
40006914.content: Rama knew he was a friend of his father. So he enquired in a cool, composed voice his name and his lineage.

40006915.author: पदार्थः
40006915.content: द्विजः  bird, रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा  hearing, सर्वभूतसमुद्भवम् the origin of all beings, कुलम् family, आत्मानमेव च about his own family, तस्मै to him, आचचक्षे started narrating.

40006915.author: Translation
40006915.content: On hearing Rama's words, the bird started narrating the origin of all beings including his own family:

40006916.author: पदार्थः
40006916.content: महाबाहो O mightyarmed, राघव Rama, पूर्वकाले in ancient times, ये those, प्रजापतय: lords of creation, अभवन् were there, तान् सर्वान् all of them, मे while I, निगदतः mention, आदितः from the beginning, शृणु listen.

40006916.author: Translation
40006916.content: O mightyarmed Rama hear from me while I am telling you about the lords of creation from the very beginning.

40006917.author: पदार्थः
40006917.content: राघव O Raghava, तेषाम् of them, प्रथमः the first, कर्दमः Kardama, विक्रीतः Vikrita, तदनन्तरः thereafter, शेषश्च Sesha, बहुपुत्र: Bahuputra, वीर्यवान्, mighty one (courageous one) संश्रयश्चैव Samsraya, स्थाणुः Sthanu, मरीचिः Mareechi, अत्रिश्च and Atri, महाबलः mighty one, क्रतुश्च Kratu, पुलस्त्यः Pulasthya, अङ्गिराश्चैव Angirasa, प्रचेताः Pracheta, तथा similarly, पुलहः Pulaha, दक्षः Daksha, अपरः after that, विवस्वान् Vivasvan, अरिष्टनेमिश्च Arishtanemi, महातेजाः very glorious, काश्यपश्च Kasyapa, तेषाम् of them, पश्चिम: later, आसीच्च became the ruler.

40006917.author: Translation
40006917.content: O Rama among the lords of all beings the first was Kardama, the next was Vikritha, followed by Sesha, Samsrya Bahuputra, Sthanu, Mareechi, Atri and mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Angirasa, Pracheta, similarly Pulaha and Daksha.Following them were Vivasvan, Arishtanemi and the very glorious Kasyapa who was the last ruler.

40006918.author: पदार्थः
40006918.content: राघव O Raghava, तेषाम् of them, प्रथमः the first, कर्दमः Kardama, विक्रीतः Vikrita, तदनन्तरः thereafter, शेषश्च Sesha, बहुपुत्र: Bahuputra, वीर्यवान्, mighty one (courageous one) संश्रयश्चैव Samsraya, स्थाणुः Sthanu, मरीचिः Mareechi, अत्रिश्च and Atri, महाबलः mighty one, क्रतुश्च Kratu, पुलस्त्यः Pulasthya, अङ्गिराश्चैव Angirasa, प्रचेताः Pracheta, तथा similarly, पुलहः Pulaha, दक्षः Daksha, अपरः after that, विवस्वान् Vivasvan, अरिष्टनेमिश्च Arishtanemi, महातेजाः very glorious, काश्यपश्च Kasyapa, तेषाम् of them, पश्चिम: later, आसीच्च became the ruler.

40006918.author: Translation
40006918.content: O Rama among the lords of all beings the first was Kardama, the next was Vikritha, followed by Sesha, Samsrya Bahuputra, Sthanu, Mareechi, Atri and mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Angirasa, Pracheta, similarly Pulaha and Daksha.Following them were Vivasvan, Arishtanemi and the very glorious Kasyapa who was the last ruler.

40006919.author: पदार्थः
40006919.content: राघव O Raghava, तेषाम् of them, प्रथमः the first, कर्दमः Kardama, विक्रीतः Vikrita, तदनन्तरः thereafter, शेषश्च Sesha, बहुपुत्र: Bahuputra, वीर्यवान्, mighty one (courageous one) संश्रयश्चैव Samsraya, स्थाणुः Sthanu, मरीचिः Mareechi, अत्रिश्च and Atri, महाबलः mighty one, क्रतुश्च Kratu, पुलस्त्यः Pulasthya, अङ्गिराश्चैव Angirasa, प्रचेताः Pracheta, तथा similarly, पुलहः Pulaha, दक्षः Daksha, अपरः after that, विवस्वान् Vivasvan, अरिष्टनेमिश्च Arishtanemi, महातेजाः very glorious, काश्यपश्च Kasyapa, तेषाम् of them, पश्चिम: later, आसीच्च became the ruler.

40006919.author: Translation
40006919.content: O Rama among the lords of all beings the first was Kardama, the next was Vikritha, followed by Sesha, Samsrya Bahuputra, Sthanu, Mareechi, Atri and mighty Kratu, Pulastya, Angirasa, Pracheta, similarly Pulaha and Daksha.Following them were Vivasvan, Arishtanemi and the very glorious Kasyapa who was the last ruler.

40006920.author: पदार्थः
40006920.content: महायशः very  glorious, राम Rama, प्रजापतेः of the lords, दक्षस्य of Daksha, षष्टिः sixty, यशस्विन्यः glorious, दुहितरः daughters, बभूवुः इति were born thus, विश्रुतम् very well known .

40006920.author: Translation
40006920.content: O glorious Rama it is wellknown that Daksha, the creator had sixty daughters of great fame.

40006921.author: पदार्थः
40006921.content: काश्यपः Kasyapa, तासाम् among them, अदितिं च Aditi and, दितिं चैव Diti too, दनुमपि and Danu, अथ also, कालिकाम् Kalika, ताम्राम् Tamra, क्रोधवशां चैव Krodhavasa too, मनुं च and Manu, अनलामपि Anala, अष्टौ eight, सुमध्यमाः of beautiful waist, प्रतिजग्राह married,

40006921.author: Translation
40006921.content: Out of them(daughters of Daksha) Kasyapa married eight women of beautiful waist called Aditi, Diti, Danu also Kalika,Tamra, Krodhavasa, Anala and Manu.

40006922.author: पदार्थः
40006922.content: ततः then, प्रीतः a pleased man, काश्यपः Kasyapa, ताः कन्याः to those young wives, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, मत्समान् equal to me, त्रैलोक्यभर्तृ़न् rulers of the three worlds, पुत्रां sons, जनयिष्यथ may give birth to.

40006922.author: Translation
40006922.content: Kasyapa, pleased with them said to his young wives, Beget sons of my stature who can rule over the three worlds.

40006923.author: पदार्थः
40006923.content: महाबाहो strongarmed, मनुजर्षभ bull among men, राम Rama, अदितिः Aditi, तन्मनाः engrossed in the thought, दितिश्च Diti, कालिका च and Kalika, शेषास्तु rest of them, अमनसः did not give serious thought, अभवन् became.

40006923.author: Translation
40006923.content: O best of men, O longarmed Rama while Aditi, Diti and Kalika seriously considered his advice, the rest of the wives did not.

40006924.author: पदार्थः
40006924.content: अरिन्दम subduer of enemies, परन्तप scorcher of enemies, अदित्याम् to Aditi, आदित्याः Adityas(twelve), वसवः Vasus(eight), रुद्राः Rudras (eleven), अश्विनौ Asvins(two), त्रयस्त्रिंशत् thirtythree, देवाः deities, जज्ञिरे were born.

40006924.author: Translation
40006924.content: O Rama, subduer and scorcher of enemies to Aditi were born twelve Adityas, eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, and two Asvins, thirtythree deities in all.

40006925.author: पदार्थः
40006925.content: तात dear child, दितिस्तु Diti bore, यशस्विनः glorious, दैत्यान् Daityas, पुत्रान् sons, अजनयत् gave birth to, सवनार्णवा including the forests and seas, इयम् this, वसुमती earth, तेषाम् to them, आसीत् belonged.

40006925.author: Translation
40006925.content: O dear Rama, Diti bore glorious sons called Daityas and this earth with all the forests and seas belonged to them.

40006926.author: पदार्थः
40006926.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, दनुः Danu, अश्वग्रीवम् Hayagriva, पुत्रम् son, अजनयत् gave birth to, कालिकापि Kalika too, नरकम् Naraka, कालकं चैव Kalaka, व्यजायत gave birth to.

40006926.author: Translation
40006926.content: O subduer of enemies, to Danu was born Hayagriva and to Kalika, Naraka and Kalaka.

40006927.author: पदार्थः
40006927.content: ताम्रापि Tamra also, क्रौञ्चीम् Krounchi, भासीम् Bhasi, तथा similarly, श्येनीम् Syeni, धृतराष्ट्रीम् Dhrutharashtri, तथा like that, शुकीम् Suki, एताः all of them, लोकविश्रुताः famous in the world, पञ्च five, कन्याः young girls, सुषुवे she gave birth to.

40006927.author: Translation
40006927.content: To Tamra were born, Krounchi, Bhasi, Syeni, Dhrutharashtri and Suki. Altogether they were five beautiful young maids famous in the world.

40006928.author: पदार्थः
40006928.content: क्रौञ्ची Krounchi, उलूकान् owls, जनयत् gave birth to, भासी Bhasi, भासान् Bhasa birds, व्यजायत delivered, श्येनी Syeni, सुतेजसः very bright, श्येनांश्च Syena birds(hawks), गृध्रांश्च Vultures, व्यजायत gave birh to, धृतराष्ट्री तु Dhrutharashtri too, हंसांश्च Swans, सर्वशः all types of swans, कलहंसांश्च waterbirds of sweet note.

40006928.author: Translation
40006928.content: Krounchi gave birth to owls, Bhasi to Bhasa birds, Synei to bright hawks and vultures, Dhrutharashtri to swans and chakravakas with sweet notes.

40006929.author: पदार्थः
40006929.content: क्रौञ्ची Krounchi, उलूकान् owls, जनयत् gave birth to, भासी Bhasi, भासान् Bhasa birds, व्यजायत delivered, श्येनी Syeni, सुतेजसः very bright, श्येनांश्च Syena birds(hawks), गृध्रांश्च Vultures, व्यजायत gave birh to, धृतराष्ट्री तु Dhrutharashtri too, हंसांश्च Swans, सर्वशः all types of swans, कलहंसांश्च waterbirds of sweet note.

40006929.author: Translation
40006929.content: Krounchi gave birth to owls, Bhasi to Bhasa birds, Synei to bright hawks and vultures, Dhrutharashtri to swans and chakravakas with sweet notes.

40006930.author: पदार्थः
40006930.content: सा she, भामिनी woman, चक्रवाकांश्चापि chakravakas too, विजज्ञे created, ते for you, भद्रम् welfare, शुकी Suki, नताम् of Nata, विजज्ञे gave birth to, विनता Vinata, नतायः from Nata, सुता daughter.

40006930.author: Translation
40006930.content: Dhrutharashtri, a female bird of great lustre gave birth to chakravakas too. Suki gave birth to Nata and from Nata, Vinata was born. Be blessed, O Rama

40006931.author: पदार्थः
40006931.content: राम Rama, क्रोधवशा Krodhavasa, मृगींच Mrugi, मृगमन्दां च Mrugamanda, हरीम् Hari, भद्रमदामपि Bhadramada, मातङ्गीमपि Matangi, शार्धूलीम् Sarduli, श्वेताम् Sweta, तथा सुरभिम् Surabhi, सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नाम् endowed with all virtues, सुरसाम् Surasa, कद्रुकामपि Kadruka, दश ten, आत्मसम्भवा offsprings, विजज्ञे were born.

40006931.author: Translation
40006931.content: O Ramato Krodhavasa were born Mrugi, Mrugamanda, Hari, Bhadramada, Mathangi, Sardooli, Sweta, Surabhi and Surasa, Kadruva and endowed with all virtues.

40006932.author: पदार्थः
40006932.content: राम Rama, क्रोधवशा Krodhavasa, मृगींच Mrugi, मृगमन्दां च Mrugamanda, हरीम् Hari, भद्रमदामपि Bhadramada, मातङ्गीमपि Matangi, शार्धूलीम् Sarduli, श्वेताम् Sweta, तथा सुरभिम् Surabhi, सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नाम् endowed with all virtues, सुरसाम् Surasa, कद्रुकामपि Kadruka, दश ten, आत्मसम्भवा offsprings, विजज्ञे were born.

40006932.author: Translation
40006932.content: O Ramato Krodhavasa were born Mrugi, Mrugamanda, Hari, Bhadramada, Mathangi, Sardooli, Sweta, Surabhi and Surasa, Kadruva and endowed with all virtues.

40006933.author: पदार्थः
40006933.content: नरवरोत्तम O best of men, सर्वे all kinds of, मृगाः animals, अपत्यम् offsprings, ऋक्षाश्च bears, सृमराः deer, तथा similarly, चमराश्च chamara deer, मृगमन्दायाः to Mrugamanda.

40006933.author: Translation
40006933.content: O best of men, all kinds of animals were born of Mrugi.To Mrugamanda were born bears and chamara (a different kind of deer).

40006934.author: पदार्थः
40006934.content: हरयः lions, वानराश्च monkeys also, तरस्स्विनः awift, हर्याः to Hari, अपत्यम् offspring, ततः as, भद्रमदा Bhadramada, इरावतीं नाम by name Iravati, सुताम् a daughter, जज्ञे gave birth to.

40006934.author: Translation
40006934.content: To Hari were born lions, and swiftmoving monkeys and to Bhadramada, a daughter by name Iravati.

40006935.author: पदार्थः
40006935.content: लोकनाथः O lord of the world, ऐरावतः Airavata, महागजः mighty elephant, तस्याः her, पुत्रः son, मनुजर्षभ O bull among men, अथ and, मातङ्गाः elephants, मातङ्ग्याः of Matangi, अपत्यम् offspring.

40006935.author: Translation
40006935.content: O bull among men Matangi gave birth to elephants.The mighty elephant Airavata who became the lord of the world was born to Iravati.

40006936.author: पदार्थः
40006936.content: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, शार्दूली Sarduli, गोलाङ्गूलांश्च playful roundbodied monkeys, व्याघ्रांश्च tigers, सुतान् sons, अजनयत् gave girth to, श्वेतापि and Sweta, दिशागजांश्च elephants of the  eight quarters of the globe, सुतान् as sons, अजनयत् gave birth to.

40006936.author: Translation
40006936.content: O Rama, Sarduli gave birth to tigers and playful, roundbodied monkeys called Golangula and Sweta delivered elephants as sons for guarding the eight quarters.

40006937.author: पदार्थः
40006937.content: राम O Rama, ततः then, सुरभिः देवी the divine Surabhi, रोहिणीं नाम by name Rohini, यशस्स्विनीम् famed, गन्धर्वीं च Gandharvi too, दुहितरौ two daughters, अजायत gave birth to, ते भद्रम् be blessed.

40006937.author: Translation
40006937.content: Surabhi gave birth to Rohini and Gandharvi,the two famous daughters. May you be happy, Rama

40006938.author: पदार्थः
40006938.content: राम Rama, रोहिणी Rohini, गाव: cows, अजनयत् procreated, गन्धर्वी Gandharvi, वाजिनः horses, सुतान् as chidren, सुरसा Surasa, नागान् cobras, कद्रूस्तु Kadru, पन्नगान् other serpents, अजनयत् procreated.

40006938.author: Translation
40006938.content: O Rama Rohini procreated cows, and Gandharvi, horses as offsprings. Surasa delivered cobras and Kadru, ordinary serpents.

40006939.author: पदार्थः
40006939.content: मनुजर्षभ O bull among men, राम Rama, मनु Manu, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, क्षत्रियान् kshtriyas, वैश्यान् vaisyas, शूद्रांश्च and sudras , यशस्विनः illustrious, मनुष्यान् human beings, पुत्रान् sons, अजनयत् procreated.

40006939.author: Translation
40006939.content: O Rama, bull among men Manu procreated brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas and sudras all famed human beings.

40006940.author: पदार्थः
40006940.content: अनलापि Anala too, पुण्यफलान् sacred fruits, सर्वान् of several kinds, वृक्षान् trees, व्यजायत procreated, विनता च and Vinata, शुकीपौत्री granddaughter of Suki, कद्रूश्च from Kadhruva सुरसास्वसा sibling of Surasa.

40006940.author: Translation
40006940.content: Anala (wife of Kasyapa) procreated trees with sacred fruits. Vinata was the granddaughter of Suki, and Kahdruva and Surasa were her sisters.

40006941.author: पदार्थः
40006941.content: कद्रूः Kadhruva, सहस्रास्यम् thousandheaded, धरणीधरम् he which held the whole earth, नागम् serpent, विजज्ञे produced, विनतायास्तु of Vinata too, गरुडः Garuda, अरुण Aruna, एव च द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons.

40006941.author: Translation
40006941.content: Kadhru produced a thousandhooded serpent(Adisesha) who held the whole earth on his head and Vinata, two sons, Garuda and Aruna.

40006942.author: पदार्थः
40006942.content: अरिन्दम O Subduer of enemies, अहम् I, तस्मात् from him, अरुणात् from Aruna, जातः was born, सम्पातिः Sampati, मम my, अग्रज: elder brother, श्येनीपुत्रम् son of Syeni, माम् me, जटायुरिति as Jatayu, विद्धि know.

40006942.author: Translation
40006942.content: I am born to Aruna and my elder brother is Sampati. O subduer of enemies, know me as Jatayu, son of Syeni.

40006943.author: पदार्थः
40006943.content: सः अहम् that I am, इच्छसि यदि if you so desire, ते to you, वाससहायः guard, भविष्यामि I shall be, दुर्गम् difficult, इदं कान्तारम् this forest, मृगराक्षससेवितम् full of wild animals and demons, तात dear, सलक्ष्मणे with Lakshmana, त्वयि you, याते having gone, सीताम् Sita, रक्षिष्ये will protect.

40006943.author: Translation
40006943.content: If you so desire I will be helpful to you in guarding your hut. O dear, it is a difficult forest full of wild animals and demons. When you and Lakshmana are away I will protect Sita.

40006944.author: पदार्थः
40006944.content: राघवः Rama, तं जटायुषम् to that Jatayu, प्रतिपूज्य having worshipped, मुदा with joy, परिष्वज्य च having embraced, सन्नतः bent down, अभवत् he became, आत्मवान् selfpossessed Rama, जटायुषा with Jatayu, पुनः पुनः again and again, सङ्कथितम् narrated, पितुः father's, सखित्वम् friendship, शुश्राव heard.

40006944.author: Translation
40006944.content: Rama worshipped  Jatayu and bending down, embraced him. He heard from him again and again several events relating to Jatayu's  friendship with his father.

40006945.author: पदार्थः
40006945.content: सः Rama, मैथिलीम् princess of Mithila, सीताम् Sita, परिदाय leaving the responsibility, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, अतिबलेन by very strong bird, तेन by that, पक्षिणासहैव with Jatayu, अनलः fire, शलभानिव like moths, रिपून् enemies, दिधक्षन् desirous of burning, तां पञ्चवटीम् that Panchavati, जगाम went.

40006945.author: Translation
40006945.content: Entresting the protection of Sita, the princess of Mithila, to that strong vulture,  Jatayu, and accompanied by Lakshmana Rama went to Panchavati wishing to destroy the enemies like fire burning the moths. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामयणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
